authorship: Developer-authored synthetic cases with AI assistance. References are calculated from the explicit project rubric, not independent human adjudication.

evaluation.methodology: 20 original development fixtures and 10 newly constructed reporting variants, frozen before model calls on the new variants. Only development outputs may guide prompt selection. Reporting variants permute field IDs/order and vary amounts, currencies and rule precedence. Developer/AI authored and known to their creator, not independently adjudicated or blinded; previous model has not been queried on the new reporting variants. Reference routing is evaluated separately and never substituted for model output. No generalization or compliance claim.
